title: Personal Capital Account Sync Stale
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalcapital:networth
stats max(_time) as last_sync by account_type
eval hours_since=(now()-last_sync)/3600
where hours_since>72
description: Finds Personal Capital accounts not synced in three days.
value: Surfacing personal capital account sync stale helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant personal finance & crypto export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It shows when personal capital account sync stale matters for your routine.
